scripts.build:openapi: cd src && composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist && composer run openapi:public && composer run openapi:private
scripts.build:php:validate: npm run build:php:validate:syntax && npm run build:php:validate:namespaces && npm run build:php:validate:use-statements && npm run build:php:validate:orm
scripts.build:php:validate:all: npm run build:php:validate:syntax:all && npm run build:php:validate:namespaces && npm run build:php:validate:use-statements && npm run build:php:validate:orm
scripts.lint:fix: node scripts/ensure-biome.js && biome check --write webpack/ && biome format --write .
scripts.test:php: php scripts/test-error-redaction.php && php scripts/test-volunteer-class-link-memo.php && php scripts/test-countries.php && php scripts/test-after-response.php && php scripts/test-config-prune.php
scripts.test:locale:full: npx cypress run --config-file cypress/configs/locale.config.ts --headless --browser electron --env LOCALE_TIER=full
scripts.docker:test:start: node scripts/docker-config.js docker/Config.php && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --profile test up -d
scripts.docker:test:login:web: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --profile test exec webserver bash
scripts.docker:test:login:db: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --profile test exec database bash
scripts.docker:test:rebuild: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --profile test build --no-cache webserver && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --profile test up -d webserver
scripts.docker:dev:start: node scripts/docker-config.js docker/Config.php && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:dev:reset:db: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml down -v && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d
scripts.docker:ci:root:start: node scripts/docker-config.js docker/Config.root.php && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-root up -d --build
scripts.docker:ci:root:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-root down -v
scripts.docker:ci:subdir:start: node scripts/docker-config.js docker/Config.parallel.subdir.php && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-subdir up -d --build
scripts.docker:ci:subdir:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-subdir down -v
scripts.docker:ci:new-system:start: node scripts/docker-config.js --remove && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-new-system up -d --build
scripts.docker:ci:new-system:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml --profile ci-new-system down -v
scripts.docker:ci:new-system:subdir:start: node scripts/docker-config.js --remove && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.subdir.yaml --profile ci-new-system up -d --build
scripts.docker:ci:new-system:subdir:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.parallel.yaml -f docker/docker-compose.subdir.yaml --profile ci-new-system down -v
scripts.docker:dev:login:web: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml exec webserver bash
scripts.docker:dev:login:db: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml exec database bash
scripts.docker:dev:build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml exec webserver bash -c "source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /home/ChurchCRM && npm ci && npm run build"
scripts.docker:dev:watch: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml exec webserver bash -c "source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /home/ChurchCRM && npm run build:webpack:watch"
